message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find the Law | |-------|------------|-----------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • 55 mph on rural interstates
• 65 mph on urban interstates
• 45 mph on rural highways (except where posted otherwise)
• 35 mph on urban highways (unless posted otherwise) | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | | **Seat‑Belt Use** | • All drivers and front‑seat passengers must wear seat belts.
• Rear‑seat passengers under 13 must use a seat belt or child restraint. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **DUI / Driving Under Influence** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal for drivers over 21.
• 0.02 % or higher is illegal for commercial drivers and drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **Texting / Phone Use** | • Drivers may not use a handheld phone while driving.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Headlights & Signal Use** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, after dark, or when visibility is reduced.
• Turn signals must be used at least 100 ft before turning or changing lanes. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Stop only if the bus is stopped and its stop sign is extended. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Lane Discipline** | • Drivers must stay in their lane unless turning or passing.
• Lane changes must be signaled and performed safely. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Vehicle Inspection & Registration** | • Vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection.
• Registration must be renewed annually and displayed on the rear license plate. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Trucks over 10,000 lb must have a commercial driver’s license (CDL).
• Bicyclists must use bike lanes where available. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | --- ### How to Find the Full Text of the Laws 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic laws. *Website:* https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TS/htm/TS.545.htm 2. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Provides guides, forms, and FAQs. *Website:* https://www.txdmv.gov/ 3. **Texas Highway Patrol** – Offers safety tips and enforcement updates. *Website:* https://www.txdhhs.gov/highwaypatrol 4. **Legal Resources** – For deeper legal analysis or case law: *Texas Law Help:* https://texaslawhelp.org/ *Texas Courts:* https://www.txcourts.gov/ --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement and saves lives. - **Avoid distractions** – no handheld phone use while driving. - **Observe posted speed limits** – they vary by road type and location. - **Be mindful of school buses** – stop when required. - **Check your vehicle’s inspection status** – an uninspected vehicle can’t legally be on the road. --- #### Need More Specific Information? If you’re looking for details on a particular aspect (e.g., DUI penalties, commercial driving regulations, or recent legislative changes), let me know and I can dive deeper or pull up the exact statutory language.
